answer: Audits are recorded in quill, queued in voyage, and beacon publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 95 identities per epoch. A farm of 205 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2420 identities would post 1413 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
